alignment: Each photo is fitted into the exact registered original SVG alpha silhouette at render time; all layers share the 1086x1448 canvas.
recolor: Photos have their original folds/shadows; Canvas blends the current Wada garment color and clips the result to the original garment alpha.

sources.tee: user-provided peach T-shirt photo, white background segmented to alpha
sources.jacket: user-provided orange blazer PNG, original alpha retained
sources.trousers: user-provided yellow trousers photo, white background segmented to alpha
sources.tie: user-provided yellow tie photo, white background segmented to alpha
sources.shirt: pre-existing WadaLens photographic shirt study, enlarged as transparent image
sources.skirt: pre-existing WadaLens photographic skirt study, enlarged as transparent image
sources.shoes: pre-existing WadaLens photographic sneaker study, enlarged as transparent image
sources.scarf: synthetic photo-textured material study made using user-provided T-shirt fabric photograph

limitations: Photographic fabric is aligned to the original 2D silhouette, not physically simulated cloth.
Facial features, hair, exposed skin and base body stay illustrated in this v2 preview.
Original user example photos were not entirely independent pose-matched garments; high-resolution texture is remapped into the WadaLens geometry.
